title: Twelve
logline: Twelve years. The walks are shorter. The panels are wider. The Dog Night plus three.

panels.composition: The dumpster. WOOD setting BARNABY down. The panel is wider than a standard panel — the strip has made room.

image.prompt: a man setting an old dog down on gravel behind a bowling alley at night, the panel wider than standard, muddy watercolor, no words
image.notes: Wider panels this year. The strip makes room for the dog to take his time.

panels.composition: The dog walking three steps to the dumpster. Three steps take a panel.

image.prompt: an old dog taking three slow steps toward a rusted dumpster under a bulb, a wide panel giving them room, no words

panels.composition: The dog sitting. Wood sitting. Wide. The bulb. Both looking at the chain-link where the rope was, twelve years ago.

image.prompt: a man and an old dog sitting side by side on gravel looking at a chain-link fence under a bulb, wide panel, no words

panels.composition: The sign. SMALL WOOD LANES with the S dark. Wood carrying the dog. Wide. Slow.

image.prompt: a man carrying an old dog away beneath a bowling-alley neon sign with its first letter dark, a wide slow panel, watercolor, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Twelve. Wide panels. The S still dark.
